display.purpose: Hero wordmark only, width axis 70%, uppercase.

title.purpose: Part names, option titles, FAQ summaries.

label.purpose: Legends, title-block terms, table heads; uppercase, 0.1em tracking.

measure.purpose: Courier Prime for measured, counted or priced values only.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Ink halo behind the paper focus ring on dark surfaces (bar, graphite sheets, cart, dock). The only box-shadow in the build.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Explode settle (1.6s), dock slide (0.5s), stamp press, accordion marker (0.3s).

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Background and colour change on stamps, chips, options and part rows.

components.name: Stamp Button
components.description: Primary square stamped action on orange sheets; inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; background: #111; color: #ff4d00; border: 3px solid #111; padding: 14px 22px; font: 800 1.0625rem 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-stretch: 80%; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-stamp:hover { background: transparent; color: #111; } .ds-stamp:active { transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #111; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ink Stamp Button
components.description: Add to cart and checkout on aluminium and in the cart.
components.css: .ds-stamp-ink { background: #111; color: #eef0f0; border: 3px solid #111; padding: 14px 22px; font: 800 1.0625rem 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-stretch: 80%; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-stamp-ink:hover { background: #ff4d00; color: #111; } .ds-stamp-ink:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #111; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: Fixed 52px ink bar with wordmark, section links and orange cart button.
components.html: GRIST ONETeardownSpecs
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; background: #111; color: #eef0f0; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-mark { margin-right: auto; font-stretch: 70%; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mark span { color: #ff4d00; } .ds-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-link:hover { border-color: #ff4d00; } .ds-cart { background: #ff4d00; color: #111; border: 0; padding: 8px 14px; font: 700 0.875rem 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cart:hover { background: #eef0f0; } .ds-bar a:focus-visible, .ds-cart:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #eef0f0; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px #111; }

components.name: Method Chip
components.description: Brew-method jump button; pressed state inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: transparent; color: #111; border: 2px solid #111; padding: 8px 12px; font: 700 0.875rem 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgba(17,17,17,.12); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #111; color: #ff4d00; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #111; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Configurator Option
components.description: Bordered tile with swatch, title and sub-line; checked fills ink.
components.css: .ds-opt { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 4px 12px; border: 2px solid #111; padding: 12px 14px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', sans-serif; color: #111; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-opt:hover { background: rgba(17,17,17,.08); } .ds-opt input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; inset: 0; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-opt:has(input:checked) { background: #111; color: #eef0f0; } .ds-opt:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid #111; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-sw { width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 2px solid #111; background: #ff4d00; grid-row: 1 / 3; } .ds-opt:has(input:checked) .ds-sw { border-color: #eef0f0; } .ds-t { font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 80%; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-s { font-size: 0.8125rem; grid-column: 2 / -1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Parts List Row
components.description: Teardown hotspot row on graphite: name left, mono dimension right; current row is orange.
components.css: .ds-parts { background: #16181a; border-top: 1.5px solid #a9b0b3; width: 360px; } .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #a9b0b3; padding: 11px 10px; color: #eef0f0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-row:hover { background: rgba(238,240,240,.08); } .ds-row[aria-current='true'] { background: #ff4d00; color: #111; } .ds-name { font: 800 1.125rem 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-stretch: 80%; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-dim { font: 400 0.875rem 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #eef0f0; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px #111; }

components.name: Title Block
components.description: Drawing title block: ruled cells of term and value, anchored at the hero bottom edge.
components.css: .ds-tb { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); margin: 0; background: #ff4d00; color: #111; border-top: 3px solid #111; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-tb div { padding: 12px 16px 14px; border-right: 1.5px solid #111; } .ds-tb div:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-tb dt { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tb dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; }

components.name: Ruled Table
components.description: Borderless spec table: 3px head and closing rules, 1.5px row rules, orange highlight cell.
components.css: .ds-ruled { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #e8eaea; color: #111; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-ruled th, .ds-ruled td { text-align: left; padding: 11px 12px 11px 0; border-top: 1.5px solid #111; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ruled thead th { font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; border-top: 3px solid #111; } .ds-ruled tr:last-child th, .ds-ruled tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 3px solid #111; } .ds-ruled td { font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-ruled .hl { font-weight: 700; background: #ff4d00; padding-left: 10px; }

narrative.overview:
The page is an engineering drawing of the object, not lifestyle photography. Linework, dimension lines, numbered balloons, title blocks and ruled tables carry the content; the product is authored in SVG and reused as line art (hero), teardown (graphite) and filled render (configurator). Sections change material rather than colour scheme: anodised signal orange, black-anodised graphite, bare aluminium grey, each a full-bleed sheet.

Density is high and square. Type is heavy, condensed and capitalised for names; a typewriter mono appears only where something is measured. Everything is a rule, a stroke or a solid fill: no gradients, no cards, no soft shadows, no rounded surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed material sheets stacked vertically; one ink (#111) does all linework on light sheets, paper on graphite.
Square stamped buttons; 1.5px and 3px ruled lines as the only dividers.
One SVG grinder drawn once, recoloured by per-sheet custom properties.
Claims are checkable in place (dial shows microns, parts list shows dimensions).
Reduced-motion collapses the scroll teardown to a static sheet.

rules.name: The Material Rule
rules.body: A section changes its material (orange, graphite, aluminium), never introduces a new hue. Every sheet is built from the seven colours above.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Linework on a light sheet is ink; on graphite it is paper. Orange is fill or ground, and on graphite it is the only active-state colour.

rules.name: The Measured-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono never sets prose or headings; it marks a value that is measured, counted or priced.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Labels, table cells and prices use tabular numerals so columns read like a schedule.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces carry no shadow. Separate with a ruled line or a change of material.

dos: Do change a section's material (orange, graphite, aluminium) to change its mood, keeping all colour within the seven tokens.
Do keep every control square with a 2-3px ink border and a 3px offset focus ring (paper plus a 6px ink halo on dark surfaces).
Do set names in uppercase condensed 800 and reserve Courier Prime for measured values.
Do divide with 1.5px or 3px rules; use title blocks and ruled tables for grouped facts.
Do label concept, sample and invented content where it appears (title block, footer, fine print).
Do provide a reduced-motion state that shows teardown content statically.
donts: Don't add gradients, tinted ramps, rounded corners or drop shadows.
Don't wrap content in cards; use rules, tiles with a 2px border, or bare layout.
Don't put a centered headline over a product photograph, a three-feature-card row, or a logo strip.
Don't use mono for prose or headings.
Don't set orange text on aluminium or light sheets; orange is ground or fill there, text on it is ink.
